# `unity vcs` command reference

Generated from Unity CLI `1.0.0-beta.10` help output.

Installed help is authoritative; this file is a versioned snapshot.

## unity vcs

- CLI version: `1.0.0-beta.10`
- Supported platforms: linux, macos, windows
- Aliases: None

Version control for Unity projects: GitHub, GitLab, self-hosted git, UVCS. Not

Unity Collaboration; see unity collab.

### Usage

`unity vcs [options] [command]`

### Subcommands

| Name | Aliases | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `setup` | — | Get this project into version control and push a first commit, asking only what cannot be detected |
| `status` | — | Show what changed, grouped by what it means to Unity, with meta-file pairing problems |
| `sync` | — | Pull safely: refuse while an Editor holds the project, pull the commits and the LFS objects, then report the reimport |
| `doctor` | — | Check the repository settings, ignore rules, LFS patterns, and package pinning a Unity project needs under version control |
| `providers` | — | Report which git provider this machine can reach, as whom, and what each host allows |
| `merge-setup` | — | Make Unity scene and prefab merges work in this repository, using the editor's UnityYAMLMerge tool |
| `switch` | — | Switch branches safely: refuse while an Editor holds the project, then report the reimport the switch causes |
| `conflicts` | — | List unresolved merge conflicts, classified by Unity type, with whether each one can merge automatically |
| `explain` | — | Explain in plain language what each branch changed in a conflicted Unity asset |
| `resolve` | — | Resolve a conflicted Unity asset with UnityYAMLMerge, or by taking one side |
| `diff` | — | Diff a scene or prefab by object and component name instead of by file id |
| `blame` | — | Show who last changed each GameObject and component in a scene or prefab |
| `summarize` | — | Summarize what a branch changed, ready to paste into a pull request |
| `affected` | — | Report which assets, assemblies, and tests a change affects |
| `hooks` | — | Manage the git hooks that run the Unity integrity checks at commit time |
| `git` | — | Git-only verbs, for the things UVCS has no equivalent of |
| `uvcs` | — | Unity Version Control reads that join cm's data to your project |

### Positional arguments

None.

### Options

| Option | Value | Required | Repeatable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | False | False | — | display help for command |
| `-V`, `--version` | — | False | False | — | output the version number |
| `--format` | `<format>` | False | False | — | Output format: human, json, tsv, ndjson, github (env: UNITY_FORMAT) |
| `--json` | — | False | False | — | Shorthand for --format json |
| `--no-banner` | — | False | False | — | Suppress the startup banner (env: UNITY_NO_BANNER) |
| `--no-pager` | — | False | False | — | Disable the pager for long output (env: UNITY_NO_PAGER) |
| `--non-interactive` | — | False | False | — | Disable interactive prompts. Useful in CI/CD environments. (env: UNITY_NON_INTERACTIVE) |
| `--quiet` | — | False | False | — | Suppress informational output (env: UNITY_QUIET) |
| `--verbose` | — | False | False | — | Show full error details including stack traces on failure (env: UNITY_VERBOSE) |
| `--color` | `<mode>` | False | False | — | Control colored output (choices: "auto", "always", "never") |
| `--no-color` | — | False | False | — | Disable colored output (shorthand for --color never) |
| `--proxy` | `<url>` | False | False | — | HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS/PAC proxy URL. Examples: http://<user>:<pass>@host:8080, socks5://host:1080, pac+http://wpad/proxy.pac (env: UNITY_PROXY) |

### Examples exposed by help

`unity vcs setup                 Set this project up for version control`
`unity vcs setup --vcs github    Skip the provider question and use GitHub`
`unity vcs status                Group your changes the way Unity sees them`
`unity vcs sync                  Pull safely, with the LFS objects`
`unity vcs doctor                Audit this repository's Unity source-control setup`
`unity vcs doctor --fix          Audit it and repair everything repairable`
`unity vcs providers             Report which git provider is ready here`
`unity vcs merge-setup           Make scene and prefab merges work here`
`unity vcs merge-setup --check   Report what needs setting up, change nothing`
`unity vcs switch main           Switch to the main branch`
`unity vcs switch main --dry-run Report what the switch costs, change nothing`
`unity vcs conflicts             List conflicts by Unity type`
`unity vcs explain <path>        Explain what each branch changed`
`unity vcs resolve --all         Merge every auto-resolvable conflict`
`unity vcs diff <path>           Read a scene change by object name`
`unity vcs blame <path>          See who last changed each object`
`unity vcs summarize --since dev Summarize the branch for a pull request`
`unity vcs affected --since main Report what a branch's changes affect`
`unity vcs hooks install         Install the Unity git hooks`
`unity vcs hooks status          See which hooks are installed`
`unity vcs git migrate-lfs       Cost the binaries already in git history`
`unity vcs git worktree add x    Work on a second branch without a cold reimport`
`unity vcs uvcs locks            See who holds a Unity Version Control lock`

### Exit codes

None.
